# Enable the test framework
CONFIG_ZTEST=y
CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y

# Enable the BBRAM driver
CONFIG_BBRAM=y

# Enable the BBRAM emulator
CONFIG_BBRAM_EMUL=y

# Enable device power management, as suggested by the function names
CONFIG_DEVICE_POWER_MANAGEMENT=y
